criteria.justification: The response immediately opens with a clear and definitive decision: "I would order an immediate rollback of the new launch."

While the response contrasts temporary PR embarrassment with long-lasting loss of trust, it does not explicitly discuss the reversibility of the rollback decision itself or how easily it could be undone if it turned out to be the wrong call.

The candidate explicitly weighs the "embarrassment" of walking back a publicly announced feature against the "catastrophic" impact of leaving core functionality broken for existing customers over several days.
The response avoids pushing for a fast fix, instead stating that the rollback will give Engineering the "several days" needed to build, test, and QA a proper fix without pressure.
The candidate provides a detailed action plan outlining subsequent steps, including providing specific scripts to the support team, updating the public status page, and briefing leadership.
